content.user_title: Test Clerk Authentication with Playwright or Cypress
content.value_statement: Authentication setup and session handling can make end-to-end tests unreliable. This skill guides Clerk testing through framework-specific documentation, development keys, testing tokens, and session reuse.
actual_capabilities: Select Clerk testing documentation for Playwright or Cypress.
Guide test environment initialization with clerkSetup().
Explain testing token setup before authentication page navigation.
Recommend Playwright globalSetup and storageState for authentication reuse.
Identify Cypress command registration through addClerkCommands().
Recommend development-instance keys and warn against production keys in tests.
limitations: The skill provides guidance, not bundled test scripts or an automated test runner.
Setup details depend on current external documentation and network access.
Tests require a configured application, a test framework, and suitable Clerk development credentials.
CLI provisioning can execute downloaded code and write credentials; review the command before running it.

best_practices: Use development-instance credentials and keep secrets outside version control.
Configure the Clerk testing token before navigating to authentication pages.

anti_patterns: Using production credentials in authentication tests.
Navigating to authentication pages before configuring the testing token.
Repeating UI sign-in in every test when reusable authentication state is suitable.

faq.question: Which testing frameworks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Clerk authentication testing with Playwright and Cypress through framework-specific documentation and setup guidance.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and documentation references. Your project needs a configured test framework and application.

faq.question: Which credentials should I use?
faq.answer: Use development-instance credentials. The skill requires a publishable key and either a Clerk secret key or a Clerk testing token.

faq.question: Why is the testing token important?
faq.answer: The testing token bypasses Clerk bot detection for test flows. Configure it before navigating to authentication pages.

faq.question: How can I reduce repeated sign-in work?
faq.answer: For Playwright, the skill recommends global setup and reusable authentication state. Keep each test context isolated.

faq.question: What should I review before running Clerk CLI initialization?
faq.answer: Review the CLI version and obtain execution approval. Initialization can create an application and write development credentials to an environment file.
